purpose: Track billing records for student enrollments.

enrollmentId.description: ID of the enrollment this invoice is linked to.

dueDate.description: Due date for the payment in YYYY-MM-DD format.

transactionId.description: Transaction ID for the payment (if paid).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was last updated.

access_patterns.parent: read if enrollmentId matches their child’s enrollment
access_patterns.lp: read if assigned to the enrollment

composite_indexes_needed.description: For querying invoices by enrollment and status.

validation_rules: status must be one of the predefined statuses.
amount must be a positive number.
dueDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
performance_notes: Indexes on enrollmentId and status are critical for invoice queries.
